insight: Built by two 20-year-old college dropouts; grew to 5M+ users and eight-figure ARR on just $750K raised. Formerly TurboLearn.
name: Turbo AI
tagline: Turns lectures, PDFs and videos into notes, flashcards, quizzes and podcasts.
description: Turbo AI is an AI study assistant that converts lecture recordings, PDFs, slides and YouTube videos into structured notes, flashcards, quizzes and audio summaries. It preserves technical formatting for math, chemistry and code, and includes a chatbot that answers questions about your uploaded material. Notes sync across web and mobile, and a free tier lets students try it before subscribing.
edge: Generates notes, flashcards, quizzes and podcasts from one upload in a single student-priced app, with strong handling of math and code.
pros: Free tier covers 2 hours of lecture transcription monthly
Handles math, chemistry and code formatting
Notes, flashcards, quizzes and audio from one upload
Web, iOS and Android with cross-device sync
cons: Free tier is quite limited (2 hrs, 1 PDF, 5 quizzes/month)
Built for studying, not general note-taking
Underlying AI model is not disclosed

references.title: 20-year-old dropouts built AI notetaker Turbo AI and grew it to 5 million users
